noSources: Nothing to record here yet. Open your meeting app and it will appear.
permissionScreenBody: macOS needs your permission before Secretary Code can record another app. Turn on Secretary Code in Privacy & Security › Screen & System Audio Recording, then quit and reopen Secretary Code.
permissionMicBody: Your microphone is saved on its own track so Lucina can tell your voice apart from everyone else’s.
unavailableTitle: Recording isn’t available in this build
unavailableBody: The native recorder is bundled only in macOS builds of Secretary Code.
settingRecordVideoHint: Turn off to record audio only.
settingResolutionHint: Lower resolutions keep files small. Native uses every pixel of the source.
settingFrameRateHint: 30 fps suits screen sharing; 60 fps suits fast motion.
settingCodecHint: Encoded in hardware on Apple silicon.
settingBitrateHint: Kilobits per second. 6000 suits 1080p screen sharing.
settingMicrophoneHint: Saved as mic.m4a. Lucina uses it to recognise your voice.
settingSystemAudioHint: Record only the app you choose, or everything your Mac plays.
settingSeparateTracksHint: Meeting audio, your microphone and video are always saved as separate files.
settingKeepDaysHint: Recordings leave this Mac only after Secretary confirms the upload and this time has passed.
settingSuggestHint: When a meeting app opens during a calendar event, Lucina offers to record. She never starts on her own.
settingsLocked: Settings are locked while a recording is running.
suggestBody: “{title}” is on your calendar and {app} is open.
invalidRequest: That request could not be sent.
helperUnavailable: The native recorder isn’t installed in this build.
permission-screen: Screen Recording is off for Secretary Code. Turn it on in System Settings, then reopen the app.
permission-microphone: Microphone access is off for Secretary Code. Turn it on in System Settings, or record without the microphone.
microphone-unavailable: The selected microphone isn’t available. Choose another one in Settings.
source-not-found: That app or window is no longer open.
capture-failed: Recording stopped early. Everything captured until then was kept.
writer-failed: Recording stopped because a file could not be written. Check free disk space.
helper-exited: The recorder stopped unexpectedly. Everything captured until then was kept.
helper-timeout: The recorder didn’t respond. Try again.
signInRequired: Sign in to Lucina to upload recordings.
checksumMismatch: The uploaded copy didn’t match the recording. It stays on this Mac; retry the upload.
rejected: Secretary refused the upload. Retry, or check that the server is up to date.
uploadFailed: The upload couldn’t finish. Retry when you’re online.
emptyRecording: Nothing was captured in this recording.
serverError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
